limitations: CUDA occupancy API results are theoretical residency, NOT measured achieved occupancy.
Recorded kernel durations are from previous separate instrumented runs, not fresh throughput timings.
Grid ceilings ignore load balance, tail effects, dependencies, memory/issue stalls and other processes.
The tool never changes launch geometry; several kernels require a fixed thread count for correctness.
Local bytes/stack alone do not prove register spilling; consult compiler/SASS evidence.
No occupancy averaging across kernels or devices is presented as achieved occupancy.

profile_scope: Separate 23-prompt/8-output model traces; not HTTP speed measurements. Non-spec control traces are reused hash-pinned from the preceding capsule; C4 control and all candidates are fresh; C1/C2/C8 and MTP controls are reused from the pinned preceding capsule. Native-range counts are not logical request counts. CPU API sums may contain waits/nesting; device work may overlap. Static resource ceilings are not achieved occupancy or bandwidth.

microbenchmark.scope:
Byte-exact old/new residual-activation projection shared-activation microbenchmark.

Pinned control/candidate binaries use the same original-source Q8 planes and
FP16 inputs. Sampled FP64 gates, exact residual output bytes and CPU/event/wall
measurements precede any inference-performance claim. Not full-model quality.
microbenchmark.dtype: FP16 input/output; original Q8/F16-scale weights. Original FP16 and residual A8 remain separate arithmetic profiles. Control/candidate residual math must be byte-identical.
